about.title: USD to JPY Calculator - Live Dollar to Yen Exchange & Conversion
about.description: Convert US Dollars (USD) to Japanese Yen (JPY) using live exchange rates. Add bank/card fees and spreads to estimate the real amount you’ll receive—great for travel budgeting, e‑commerce, and money transfers.

howTo.title: How to Use the USD to JPY Calculator

steps.title: Enter USD Amount
steps.description: Input the dollar amount to convert into yen.

steps.title: Choose Rate
steps.description: Use the mid‑market rate or your bank/provider's quoted rate.

steps.title: Add Fees (Optional)
steps.description: Include fixed/percentage fees to model the actual outcome.

steps.title: View Result
steps.description: See the converted JPY and the breakdown of rate and fees.

tips: JPY typically has no minor unit in cash—rounding may apply at ATMs/merchants.
Rates can move quickly around economic announcements.
Avoid weekend markups and DCC at ATMs when possible.

faq.q: Why is my JPY amount lower than the mid‑market rate suggests?
faq.a: Banks and cards add spreads and fees on top of the base rate.
JPY cash transactions usually have no decimals; rounding may apply.

faq.q: What is the cheapest way to get yen?
faq.a: Compare low‑fee providers and decline Dynamic Currency Conversion when prompted.
Yes, FX rates fluctuate continuously based on market conditions.

faq.q: Is the ATM rate the same as my bank's?
faq.a: Not always. ATMs/merchants may offer DCC with worse rates than your bank.
